workspace.connection.title: Developer connection
workspace.connection.description: Connect a supported MCP client to this project's declared application tools.
workspace.connection.source_listener_loo: Local listener address · for clients on this computer
workspace.connection.unconfigured: Ask an administrator to configure SUMA_PUBLIC_URL with a client-reachable address. The endpoint path alone is not a connection URL.
workspace.connection.clipboard_failed: Cannot access the clipboard. Copy the displayed configuration manually.
workspace.connection.invalid_response: Connection details do not match the current project or supported declaration contract. Refresh to read them again.
workspace.connection.environment: Provide a current project Agent or API token through SUMA_MCP_TOKEN in the client process environment, then open a new client session. This template contains no credential and does not change your Codex configuration.
workspace.connection.context: The fixed account and organization headers preserve this original context; they grant no permission. After changing identity, copy the configuration again. The language header follows the selected interface language.
workspace.connection.declaration: This is the server's tool declaration, not a test of your client or token. Every call rechecks current project permissions.
workspace.connection.empty: No tools are declared for this connection.
workspace.connection.permission_boundary: Agent credentials retain the four original read tools. Current project API credentials may use authorized reads and draft writes. Runner and browser credentials cannot connect through MCP; review, acceptance, publication, dispatch and process execution are not exposed.
workspace.ide.intro: Edit files in the bound project directly. Saving checks the file hash so external changes are never silently overwritten.
workspace.ide.interface_unavailable: The current service has not enabled the file workspace interface.
workspace.ide.dirty_navigation: This file has unsaved changes. Save it or recover the original request before switching projects or pages.
workspace.ide.pending_open: Recover the previous save receipt before opening another file.
workspace.ide.dirty_open: This file has unsaved changes. Save or revert them before opening another file.
workspace.ide.select_file: Select a file to start editing
workspace.ide.reconcile_title: The previous save needs its actual result verified
workspace.ide.reconcile_help: Use an external editor to restore the original or submitted file version, then choose “Recover previous save”. This page retains the original request and will not bypass an unknown result with a new file hash.
workspace.ide.foreign_operation: This operation came from another file or session. An administrator must use its original record to recover it; this page cannot infer its original content.
workspace.ide.recovery_basis: View the original request's recovery evidence
workspace.ide.conflict_help: Your draft is still in the editor. Compare the latest content, adopt its version as the save basis, then merge your changes manually.
workspace.ide.keep_draft: Keep draft and update version basis
workspace.ide.review_merge: Compare your current draft with the latest version before saving the merged content.
workspace.ide.editor_language_boundary: Monaco's built-in menus and editor language diagnostics currently use English. The platform's file controls and request errors follow your selected language.
workspace.ide.empty_title: Work on real project files here
workspace.ide.empty_description: Choose a file on the left, edit it, then press Ctrl/Cmd+S to save.
workspace.ide.unbound: This project has no controlled working directory bound yet.
workspace.ide.path_hint: The directory must be inside the server's configured SUMA_WORKSPACE_ROOT. Binding requires administrator permission.
workspace.token.title: Create a project access token
workspace.token.description: Tokens are bound to the current project, expire after {{hours}} hours and are shown only once when created.
workspace.token.admin_only: Only organization owners or administrators can create access tokens.
workspace.token.label: Token label
workspace.token.scope_runner_help: Access only this project's /runner routes to claim tasks, send heartbeats and return results.
workspace.token.scope_agent_help: Access only this project's Agent tool interfaces for tool discovery and invocation.
workspace.token.scope_api_help: Access the current project's API. The server still verifies specific permissions.
workspace.token.unknown: The creation receipt is unknown; the credential may already exist. Repeated submission has stopped. Ask an administrator to verify the original operation; this page cannot recover the token value.
workspace.token.receipt_preserved: This notice stays in the current browser session and does not automatically resend the creation request.
workspace.token.receipt_not_persisted: Browser storage is unavailable. Keep this page open and retain the original operation ID; reloading may remove this notice. Do not submit another creation request until the original operation is verified.
workspace.token.clipboard_failed: Cannot access the clipboard. Copy the token manually.
workspace.token.runner_instructions: Use the project's runtime documentation to set the API address, project ID and Runner token, then start suma-runner. Agent and tool adapters each need their own configuration.
workspace.token.agent_instructions: Use an Agent-scoped token for the current project's tool discovery and invocation interfaces. This credential cannot claim Runner tasks.
workspace.token.api_instructions: Include the current project ID and Bearer credential as described in the API documentation. The server still verifies every operation's permissions.
workspace.token.outcome_unknown: The credential creation result has not been confirmed. Repeated submission has stopped. Ask an administrator to verify the original operation.
workspace.token.request_pending: The credential creation request is still being processed.
workspace.invitation.outcome_unknown: The acceptance result has not been confirmed. Use normal sign-in to recover your organization session.
workspace.invitation.request_pending: The invitation is being confirmed. Wait for its receipt.
workspace.queue.title: Ready queue
workspace.queue.label: Actual ready queue
workspace.queue.description: Inspect nodes awaiting dispatch, their blockers and run details.
workspace.queue.run_invalid: Use a run ID of up to 100 letters, numbers, periods, underscores or hyphens. Start with a letter or number.
workspace.queue.scope_invalid: This link has an invalid queue scope. Clear the scope or apply new filters to load results.
workspace.queue.filtered_count: {{count}} match the filter among loaded records
workspace.queue.filtered_empty: No matching nodes among the loaded records. Change the filter or load more when available.
workspace.queue.unconfirmed: The current queue is unconfirmed. Any records below are from the last successful read.
workspace.queue.refreshing: Reading the queue. Previously loaded records remain visible.
workspace.queue.conditions_unknown: Current scheduling conditions are unconfirmed. Open the node to read them. This entry may have been claimed since it was read.
workspace.queue.next_dispatch: These checks reflect the last read. Admission is checked again when work is claimed.
workspace.queue.empty: No ready nodes in this read. Nodes awaiting dependencies, approval or a timer are outside this queue.
workspace.queue.loaded: Loaded {{loaded}} of {{total}} ready nodes in this scope. Status filters cover loaded nodes.
workspace.pagination.invalid_page: The list response has no valid records or total.
workspace.recovery.resource_description: The old resources referenced by this tab are no longer available. Manually load the current version to continue with your original project and page.
workspace.recovery.error_title: This page cannot be displayed right now
workspace.recovery.error_description: The interface encountered an error. Reload the current page or return to the project overview.
workspace.recovery.preserved: The current address is preserved. Content already saved to the project will be read from the server again; this page will not refresh automatically.
